```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

> This page is an archived copy of NASA OBPG's documentation
> *Integerized Sinusoidal Binning Scheme for Level 3 Data*
> ([original](https://oceancolor.gsfc.nasa.gov/resources/docs/format/l3bins/)),
> recovered from the
> [Wayback Machine capture of 6 January 2026](https://web.archive.org/web/20260106075308/https://oceancolor.gsfc.nasa.gov/resources/docs/format/l3bins/)
> and reproduced here for reference with attribution. The original is a work
> of the US Government. Figures are the thumbnails from the saved page;
> full-size versions link to the original site. The raw capture and the
> Markdown source live in the package under `inst/l3bins/`.

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
lines <- readLines(
  file.path("..", "..", "inst", "l3bins", "l3bins.md"),
  encoding = "UTF-8"
)
# Drop the first level-1 heading; the page title comes from the YAML front matter
h1 <- which(grepl("^# ", lines))[1]
if (!is.na(h1)) lines <- lines[-h1]
cat(lines, sep = "\n")
```
